artifact.name: knix.img
artifact.role: GPT disk with a 512 MiB FAT32 EFI system partition and an ext4 root; native rootfs, self-built 7.2.15 kernel, 773 modules (including virtio-gpu and virtio-input), guest-owned initramfs, systemd-boot and a guest-owned DRM device

seed.name: debian-13-generic-arm64.qcow2
seed.role: one-time package source and helper boot; not a product capability source

build_baseline.rule: build.sh --build refuses to assemble when any guest-produced summary or the package lockfile differs from these locked values

build_stages: platform/image/build-kernel.sh --apply (inside the arm64 Linux build guest)
platform/image/build-rootfs.sh --apply (inside the arm64 Linux build guest; also writes package-versions.txt)
platform/image/build.sh --build (on the host; verifies the locked baseline, assembles, UEFI cold-boots, verifies identity/brand/graphics, writes the receipt)
verification: uname -m is aarch64 and uname -r is 7.2.15
/lib/modules/7.2.15 carries the recorded module count and modules.dep
modprobe loads a module without vermagic or unknown-symbol errors
4 brand assets are byte-identical to docs/brand/
no cloud-init state, no seed bootloader, no failed units
boots from its own EFI system partition with no -kernel, no seed ISO and no EFI boot variables
cfg80211 loads the upstream-signed regulatory.db without a rejection in dmesg
/dev/dri/card0 and renderD128 are guest-owned DRM nodes bound to virtio_gpu
card0-Virtual-1 exposes a 1280x800 mode and guest virtio keyboard/pointer nodes exist
sway 1.10.1 starts on the DRM backend; swaymsg reports Virtual-1 active
the sway log shows an allocated GBM buffer and a created GL FBO
foot connects as a Wayland client, appears in get_tree and commits wlr_surfaces
serial console and ssh remain available with GPU=none on boot-dev.sh
build.sh compares every kernel/rootfs summary field and both lockfiles against build_baseline before assembling
scripts/verify-repro.py checks all pinned inputs, the lockfile and the absence of binary build artifacts

boot.esp: 512 MiB FAT32 on /dev/vda1; removable path EFI/BOOT/BOOTAA64.EFI

graphics.fallback: GPU=none on boot-dev.sh keeps the serial console and ssh
graphics.known_limitation: the headless verification runs sway as root without a logind seat, so swaymsg -t get_inputs is empty; the guest kernel owns the virtio input nodes and a real seatd/logind session takes them over

receipt: platform/image/build.sh writes $KNIX_DEV_DIR/BUILD-RECEIPT.json (schema 3) with the artifact sha256, the canonical build_baseline sha256, graphics verification result and every build input digest
